protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the cross-sectional-basis-conditioned flow complement to EVAL-65 (unconditional flow), EVAL-77 (unconditional cross-sectional basis) and EVAL-78 (flow x single-underlying surface); none measured flow conditioned on the cross-sectional basis
protocol.signal: causal options order-flow imbalance z (EVAL-61/62 build_states, expanding-z-scored) times causal cross-sectional near-ATM IV basis z (EVAL-77 rel = signal[ETH] - signal[BTC], forward-filled then expanding-z-scored end-of-bar k): x_k = oflow_z_k * basis_z_k
protocol.target: rv = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp bars (EVAL-71 definition), per underlying, on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(x_k, rv_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, basis-conditioned buy-heavy flow amplifies into higher subsequent realized vol)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the realized-vol series

protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH, at least one config (basis leg x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

floor.note: EVAL-79 consumes both underlyings' trade-tape IV surfaces (cross-sectional basis) and both options order-flow tapes. It composes the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor (applied to EACH underlying, reused verbatim, neither weakened) with an options order-flow adequacy floor (>= min_oflow_states_per_underlying priceable per-bar order-flow states per underlying) and a cross-sectional alignment floor (>= min_aligned_common_bars common bar-ends on the coarsest grid). This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
